verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped or least-privilege API keys for LangSmith, such as per-workspace, read-only, or role-limited keys. The closest item, Agent Auth, lets agents reach external systems with OAuth 2.0 credentials. That is a related but different feature, and nothing in it describes scoping or restricting privileges.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
